# Giacomo Patella

> Senior product designer in Florence, Italy. Over a decade designing digital
> products end to end — research, interface, design system — and building the
> front-end when it counts. Contact: gp@gpcodes.com

## Work

- [Passionfruit](https://gpcodes.com/#passionfruit): current role — case study in preparation
- [hundo](https://gpcodes.com/#hundo): Gen Z learning platform with a built-in skills wallet, launched 2022; led the entire design process
- [PwC — Consulting Source](https://gpcodes.com/#pwc): global knowledge management system; search redesign and components library; 20K monthly users, 1.23M downloads, 2.3M page views (2021)
- [Okappy](https://gpcodes.com/#okappy): connections database redesign and full UX process work
- [Octopus Energy — Powerloop](https://gpcodes.com/#octopus): gamified EV night-charging pilot, via Play Consulting
- [Redington — FRANK-E](https://gpcodes.com/#redington): pensions dashboard making scheme metrics legible to decision makers
- [IPC — Ecosystem prototype](https://gpcodes.com/#ipc): 50+ screen fintech prototype; the client's customer invested a six-figure sum to develop it further
